question.text: How and why does the density of liquid water change on prolonged electrolysis?

options.text: Decreases, as the proportion of $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ increases
Increases, as the proportion of $\mathrm{D}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ increases

solution.text:
Hint: 
$\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ decomposes preferentially. Consequently $\mathrm{D}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ concentration increases and density increases.
